items.name: Sliced beef steak (sirloin/flank) with seasoned crumb and tomato topping
items.preparation: pan-seared or grilled, sliced, topped with herbs, tomato and crumbs

items.name: Cooking oil (olive)
items.preparation: used to sauté the vegetables and sear the meat; amount assumed, not seen

scale_cues: Used the square white dinner plate, about 26–27 cm across, as the main size reference. I also used the width of the green beans (about 0.7–1 cm) and the size of the rice grains. A fork handle at the top-left edge confirmed the plate size.
assumptions: I only counted the main square plate. The side plate on the left (black olives, cherry tomatoes and shredded carrot) is cut off at the edge of the photo, so I treated it as a separate dish and left it out.
I assumed the meat is lean-to-medium beef. If it is liver or lamb, the calories and protein would be somewhat different.
The topping on the meat (crumbs or grain with tomato) is counted as part of the meat item.
The cooking oil is an estimate based on how the food looks sautéed or roasted. No oil is visible on the plate.
